caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object resembles a cylindrical structure with a slightly convex and curved top edge that flares outward at both sides, resembling the brim of a hat or a saddle. The body of the object is decorated with intricate patterns, including diamond and triangular motifs, crosshatching, and banded sections. The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and black, giving it a monochromatic appearance. Below and to the right of the object, the name "Michael Trekur" is written in a stylized script. There is a faint horizontal scale with notations at the bottom left, marked from 0 to 3.
title: Glass Hat
